title: AI Trainer
description: Salary: P25,000 to P30,000 for the duration (20 hours a week x 3 weeks) Hiring: AI Trainer / AI Implementation Specialist (3-Week Contract – Remote) We are looking for an AI-certified professional or AI implementation specialist to train our internal teams on how to effectively use AI tools and automation in their daily work. This role will involve delivering a structured 3-week training program where different departments will be trained one by one. The goal is to help our teams integrate AI into their workflows to improve productivity, efficiency, marketing output, customer support, and data management. The trainer will work with the following departments: Sales Account Management Tech Support Marketing Data Migration / Data Operations You will introduce practical AI tools, workflows, and real-life use cases that our teams can immediately apply in their roles. Create simple documentation, SOPs, and guides so teams can continue using AI after the training. Assist the team in implementing AI into existing workflows and systems. Experience conducting training sessions, workshops, or corporate AI coaching. Ability to translate AI tools into practical workflows for teams. Strong understanding of AI productivity tools, marketing AI, and automation platforms. Excellent communication and presentation skills. Experience working with remote teams is a plus. Project Details Duration: 3 Weeks Location: Remote Training Setup: Department-by-department sessions Team Size: Multiple departments will be trained sequentially Preferred Experience Implementing AI across business operations Training teams on AI workflow automation Experience with AI marketing tools and creative AI platforms Familiarity with sales, marketing, support, and operations workflows

title: Partnership for Headhunters: Long-term Bulk Recruitment of Online ESL English Teachers
job_title: Partnership for Headhunters: Long-term Bulk Recruitment of Online ESL English Teachers
description: We are an educational institution with over ten years of industry experience and a large stable student base. As our business continues to expand, we have launched a new online English tutoring platform. We are now recruiting a large number of qualified online English teachers from the Philippines. We sincerely extend a cooperation invitation to headhunters and agencies with high-quality, stable and large-scale teacher resources. We welcome partnership discussions to achieve resource complementarity and long-term win-win cooperation. Recruitment Requirements 1.Able to steadily supply Filipino teachers in bulk, flexibly adjust the number of candidates according to our needs, and support long-term continuous cooperation. 2.All provided Filipino teachers must have fluent oral English proficiency and hold official teaching certifications such as TESOL or TEFL . 3.Teachers are required to have one-on-one English teaching experience (online teaching experience is preferred). They should be skilled in one-on-one teaching for kids and children, with excellent classroom interaction and communication abilities. 4.Cooperate with us in arranging trial lessons and qualification verification to ensure authentic personal information and qualified teaching capabilities. Our Cooperation Advantages 1.Stable & High Demand: We own a large student group with consistent booking needs throughout morning, afternoon and evening peak hours. 2.Efficient Cooperation Process: Dedicated communication channel and exclusive staff for screening and follow-up. Transparent review procedures greatly improve cooperation efficiency. 3.Guaranteed Commission Payment: Commission is settled per successfully onboarded teacher, paid every two weeks with no payment delays. 4.Long-term In-depth Collaboration: Exclusive partnership will be established for outstanding partners with high-quality resources and efficient services, with priority access to all our recruitment demands. Requirements for Partners 1.Individual recruiters or formal agencies with direct access to Filipino teacher resources, no multi-level intermediaries, ensuring stable supply and reasonable cost. 2.Capable of preliminary screening, including qualification checks and oral assessments, to provide pre-qualified candidates and reduce communication costs for both sides. 3.Cooperate with trial lesson assessments, pre-service training arrangements, and daily coordination such as schedule adjustments and basic issue feedback. 4.Uphold integrity in cooperation. Ensure all teacher information and certifications are authentic; no fake credentials or inexperienced teachers shall be recommended. All cooperation terms must be strictly followed. 5.Conduct internal screening to exclude teachers with poor work attitude and inactive communication habits. 6.Serious inquiries only. Cooperation Scope & Services 1.Partners provide bulk resumes and basic information of Filipino teachers that meet our standards in terms of quantity, teaching experience and course adaptability. 2.After we complete resume screening and online interviews to confirm employment, partners assist with follow-up onboarding coordination. 3.Partners maintain daily basic communication with teachers to ensure smooth teaching operations. 4.Both sides conduct regular reviews to adjust teacher supply quantity and optimize cooperation procedures according to business development. Cooperation Process 1.Demand Communication: Partners contact us and introduce their resource scale, teacher qualifications and supply capacity; both parties confirm detailed cooperation terms and models. 2.Resource Verification: Partners send sample teacher profiles for our qualification review and trial lessons to verify overall resource quality. 3.Trial Cooperation: Start small-scale trial cooperation to run in workflows. After confirming teaching quality and service performance, formal long-term bulk recruitment cooperation will be launched with commission settlement executed as agreed. Note Interested partners please attach a brief introduction of your Filipino teacher resources (scale, certification proportion, supply capacity, etc.) when contacting us for quick review and follow-up arrangement.

title: HubSpot Implementation Specialist
description: We need a senior, hands-on HubSpot Marketing Ops implementer to turn around our campaign operating model in 4 weeks. We’ve made some progress on lifecycle/MQL/scoring, but campaigns are not consistently set up, preventing reliable attribution and reporting. This is an implementation role (build/fix), not advisory. You must be able to execute independently, quickly, and accurately. What success looks like after 4 weeks - Campaign owners can launch campaigns using a repeatable checklist (naming, UTMs, asset association, QA) - HubSpot campaigns have consistent setup and correct asset association (email s, forms, landing pages, ads where applicable) - Campaign reporting shows contacts + conversions by campaign and can be validated against underlying records - MQL/lifecycle/scoring logic is aligned to a single source of truth (no conflicting “MQL” definitions) - Email health basics are in place (suppression, segmentation hygiene, unengaged approach) - Documentation + training are delivered so the team can maintain standards without constant support Scope & responsibilities 1) Campaign audit + Campaign checklist Audit the last 10–15 campaigns and identify where tracking breaks (UTMs, missing assets, dates, naming, conversion points) Create a Campaign “Definition of Done” checklist including: - naming convention - required campaign fields (owner, dates, goal, budget fields if used) - UTM standard + tracking URL process - asset association rules (email s/forms/pages/ads) - QA steps before launch 2) Campaign templates + operating model - Build reusable templates for key campaign types: - Webinar/Event - Content/Download - Paid/Partner - Standardise setup so attribution is consistent across campaign types - Implement lightweight governance to prevent regression (permissions/QA gate/approval step) 3) Attribution + reporting baseline for campaigns - Ensure conversion points are consistently trackable and attributable: - form submissions - meeting booked (where trackable) -  webinar/event registrations and attendance (tool-agnostic) -  Build a campaign dashboard v1 showing: - contacts associated/influenced by campaign - conversions by campaign (forms + meetings where possible) - clear metric definitions and validation notes 4) MQL gate + lifecycle stage alignment (single source of truth) - Confirm and enforce one source of truth for: - what counts as MQL - lifecycle stage movement - scoring thresholds - Clean up lifecycle stages and align to Salesforce reality: - HubSpot owns Lead/MQL logic - Salesforce owns SQL/outcomes/opportunities/pipeline 5) Lead scoring (Fit + Intent) Implement/adjust scoring so it reflects Codal ICP and intent: Fit: title/seniority + industry (company size when available) Intent: page groups (contact us/work/capabilities/events), conversions, meeting booked, email replies Ensure scoring does not inflate MQL incorrectly (e.g., “any form submission” without exclusions) 6) Email health + segmentation hygiene - Audit list health (bounces, unsubscribes, unengaged segment, spam risks) - Implement: - suppression lists (internal, customers, competitors, no-consent, hard bounce) - unengaged/re-engagement approach - segmentation structure (ICP/persona + intent-based segments) 7) Salesforce alignment (in collaboration with Sales Ops) - Collaborate with Salesforce owner to ensure: -SQL/outcomes sync back to HubSpot for visibility (nurture/disqualified/opp) - mapping rules are documented and consistent - You won’t own Salesforce architecture, but you must drive clean coordination for reporting. Deliverables (non-negotiable) By end of 4 weeks you will deliver: Campaign Governance Pack (naming, UTMs, asset checklist, QA checklist) Campaign templates (webinar/event, content, paid/partner) Campaign audit summary (10–15 campaigns reviewed + fix plan) Campaign dashboard v1 (contacts + conversions by campaign + metric definitions) MQL/lifecycle/scoring alignment summary (single source of truth + workflow logic) Email hygiene + segmentation improvements (suppression + unengaged approach) Training + SOPs + Loom walkthrough Change log / handover pack (what changed, where it lives, how to maintain it) Required experience 5+ years hands-on HubSpot Marketing Ops / HubSpot implementation Proven campaign governance delivery (UTMs + templates + enforcement) Strong data hygiene capability (properties, lists, forms, duplicates approach) Comfortable building workflows, dashboards, and guardrails Experience collaborating with Salesforce teams (handoff + reporting constraints) Execution mindset: you can implement quickly with minimal supervision (not “learning on the job”)

title: HOA Manager
description: The HOA Property Manager is responsible for the day?to?day operations, governance support, vendor oversight, and owner/resident experience across an assigned portfolio of homeowner associations. The manager serves as the primary liaison among the Board of Directors, unit owners, residents, vendors, and internal teams (Maintenance and Finance), ensuring that association operations comply with governing documents, applicable laws, and company standards while meeting service-level and financial targets. Key Outcomes (What Success Looks Like): Accurate, timely Board packets and meeting facilitation with clear minutes and action logs Portfolio-level adherence to budgets, assessments, and reserve funding plans in partnership with Finance HOA Proactive maintenance planning and on-time completion of preventive and corrective work with Maintenance HOA High owner/resident satisfaction, timely resolution of requests, and transparent communications Clean annual audits, renewed insurance policies, and documented compliance with statutes and governing documents Up-to-date task/project management in Asana and on-time delivery of recurring HOA cycles and filings Key Responsibilities: 1) Board & Governance Management Serve as the primary point of contact for Board members; prepare agendas, Board packets, and management reports for regular and special meetings. Interpret and apply governing documents (CC&Rs, bylaws, rules) and relevant state statutes in daily operations; coordinate with counsel when required. Facilitate annual meetings, elections, and owner notices in accordance with legal and governing document requirements. 2) Owner & Resident Relations Maintain responsive, professional communication with trustees/Board, unit owners, and residents via email , phone, and portal. Issue timely association-wide notices (policy changes, maintenance schedules, community events, compliance reminders). Manage and resolve escalations, complaints, architectural review requests (ARC), violations, and hearings within established SLAs. 3) Financial Coordination & Reporting Support budget development, reserve study implementation, and monthly variance commentary; review financials for accuracy. Monitor assessment billing, collections, payment plans, and delinquency follow-up in alignment with collection policies. Review and approve invoices, code expenses to budgets, and validate vendor work completion prior to payment. 4) Maintenance, Projects & Vendor Management (with Maintenance HOA) Translate Board priorities into annual maintenance calendars; schedule and track preventive maintenance and inspections. Open, monitor, and close work orders; ensure scope, SLA, and quality standards are met; maintain accurate asset records. Bid, negotiate, and manage vendor contracts (landscaping, janitorial, security, pools, roofing, elevators, etc.); perform periodic vendor reviews. Process resale and lender questionnaire packages accurately and within service timelines; maintain fee schedules. Maintain organized digital records (governing docs, minutes, contracts, insurance, warranties, architectural files) in the association’s repository. 6) Team Leadership & Development Train and onboard new APMs/PMs on processes, systems (Asana, accounting/portal), compliance, and customer service standards. Promote a collaborative, service-oriented culture aligned with company values; escalate staffing/resource needs to the Unit Head. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs): On-time completion rate for recurring HOA tasks and compliance filings Work-order first-response and average time-to-close (by priority) Delinquency rate and collections effectiveness; percent of assessments collected Budget adherence (OPEX/CapEx) and variance accuracy; invoice cycle time Owner/resident satisfaction score; complaint resolution time Board satisfaction score (post-meeting surveys) and action-item closure rate Qualifications: 3+ years of HOA/condo association management or related property management experience Demonstrated proficiency with task/project management tools (Asana) and owner portals; strong Excel/Google Sheets skills Exceptional communication (written and verbal), meeting facilitation, and stakeholder management Strong analytical, organizational, and time-management skills; high attention to detail Working knowledge of governing documents, meeting procedures, collections, elections, and common HOA statutes

title: Operations manager
description: Who We Are: Ji Martial Arts is a martial arts brand founded by brothers Joel and Joshua Iyalla. Joshua is a 3x British Taekwondo Champion and Guinness World Record holder. Together they are content creators with a combined 3.5 million followers, known for high-energy martial arts content, world record attempts, and comedy challenges. The brand was built on that audience. Our content drives awareness, and our products — resistance bands and martial arts equipment — are sold worldwide via our Shopify store. We are a small, fast-moving team. We don't overcomplicate things. We expect the people we work with to take ownership of their area, communicate clearly, and get things done without being chased. Your Role: You are the Operations Manager for Ji Martial Arts. Your job is to keep the business running smoothly across four core areas — YouTube content, UGC, finance and organisation, and Facebook ads. You are not just executing tasks. You are managing and building systems, documenting them, and making sure everything is replicable without you having to explain it twice. When something looks off, you flag it. When a process could be better, you say so. Growth is always on your mind — whatever you're working on, you're always asking how we can do it better. If Joel and Joshua go away for weeks, the business doesn't just survive — it thrives. That is the standard we are hiring to. What You Own: 1. YouTube Long-Form Content: You own the end-to-end workflow for 7 videos per week. The system is built. You run it, improve it, and grow it. This includes idea generation using our Notion bot, managing the editor through briefing and approval, scheduling, thumbnails, titles, and descriptions. You own the performance data and bring a clear point of view every week on how we grow the channel. 2. UGC Creator System: You oversee our UGC pipeline — onboarding creators, managing their deliverables, and maintaining the content bank in Airtable and Notion. You keep the pipeline clean and always look for ways to improve the quality and output of the creator pool. 3. Organisation & Finance: Notion and Airtable are our operational nervous system. Xero is our financial backbone. You keep all three clean, current, and easy to navigate. You create SOPs and Loom walkthroughs for every process so nothing lives only in someone's head. You flag financial anomalies early — nothing slips. 4. Facebook Ads — Backup Ownership: Joel and Joshua run the ads day-to-day. When we're unavailable, you step in fully — writing scripts, briefing the editor, reviewing creatives, and uploading to Ads Manager with the correct copy and settings (You’ll have SOP’s to follow to make this easy). You handle it independently and flag us only when something genuinely needs our eyes. 5. Run the Business: This is the underlying point of everything above. If Joel and Joshua are away for four weeks, six weeks, or longer — the business does not slow down. It grows. You are not a caretaker. You are the person who keeps Ji moving, improving, and scaling in our absence. Every system you build, every process you document, every decision you make should be with that standard in mind. Tools You'll Use: *(Includes but is not limited to)* | Notion | Operating hub — SOPs, scripts, content system | | Airtable | UGC content bank and pipeline management | | Xero | Financial tracking and reconciliation | | YouTube Studio | Scheduling and performance analysis | | Meta Ads Manager | Ad backup — campaign management and uploading | | Loom | SOP and process documentation | | Claude/ chatgpt | Expediting efficiency and brainstorming | How Your Week Works: - YouTube — scripting, editor coordination, scheduling, and performance review on a rolling weekly basis in line with the 7-video target - UGC — creator communications and pipeline management are ongoing - Organisation — Notion and Airtable are always tidy; Xero is never left to fall behind, statements reconciled weekly - Ads — when needed, you're ready to step in without a handover Who We're Looking For: - Proven operations or systems management experience — we will not be your training ground - Strong Notion skills — fluent and able to optimise existing workspaces - Comfortable with Airtable and basic financial literacy in Xero - Experience building SOPs and documenting processes via Loom - Experience coordinating remote creative teams The person: proactive, self-directed, communicative, intuitive, growth-minded. You don't wait to be told what to do — you tell us what you're doing. Radio silence is not in your How We Communicate: - A brief message at the start of your day — what you're working on - A summary at the end of the day — what got done and what didn't - Weekly video call with Joel and Joshua — sync, progress, priorities - All communication via WhatsApp group We are not micromanagers. What we expect is simple: we never have to chase you. Growth & Progression: This starts at ~15 hours per week at $8–$10/hr. As Ji scales, hours increase, your team grows beneath you, and your pay grows with it. We are scaling fast and actively looking to hand more of the business over to the right person. This is a long-term role with real progression — not a short-term contract. How to Apply: Complete our short application form below — five focused questions. title: Senior Product Intelligence Analyst (Amazon DTC, US Supplement Brand)
job_title: Senior Product Intelligence Analyst (Amazon DTC, US Supplement Brand)
description: PHP 208,000/month base. Bonus on top. Direct hire by a US founder who's built two supplement brands in the New York area. Not an agency. Not a BPO. You'll be the senior analyst seat at a US-based supplement and functional food company. You live inside Amazon Brand Analytics, SmartScout, Helium 10, and DataDive every day. You spot category opportunities. You write the niche analyses that drive what products we launch. You iterate with our internal AI systems to land usable outputs. This is strategic work. Not data entry. Not VA tasks. Not transcription. ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- THE JOB You're our detective and our analyst. You don't formulate. You don't run ads. You don't manage anyone. Half the week, you live in Brand Analytics, SmartScout, Helium 10, DataDive, Kalodata, and on competitor product pages. You're watching click share shift on the keywords that matter. You're noticing when an emerging brand jumps three tiers in 60 days and asking why. You're tracking which branded ingredients are getting picked up by which mid-market brands. You're spotting new entrants before they hit page one. You're catching what's trending on Reddit and Google Trends before it shows up on Amazon BA. The other half, you turn observations into niche analyses and iterate with our AI product development system. When something is worth pursuing, you produce a structured research document defining the opportunity: market size, keyword landscape with realistic and stretch targets, top 10 competitor table with revenue and formulas, competitor packaging analysis, regulatory flags, and a clear strategic angle with competitive positioning recommendation. Tight. Opinionated. Numbers cited. That analysis plus our weekly market intelligence report feed into an internal AI-powered product development system. The system produces proposals, packaging concepts, wireframes, spec sheets, and supplier quotes. Cadence: 1-2 niche analyses per week from initial research through final brief. ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ THE WEDGE DISCIPLINE Every niche analysis must answer one sentence: why does a customer click us instead of the top three incumbents already on page one? Format wedge. Ingredient wedge. Audience wedge. Claim wedge. One of those four has to be defensible, or the analysis isn't ready to ship to the build pipeline. You will be the person who finds that wedge and writes the case for it. If you read this and think "yeah, obviously," we should talk. --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- YOU QUALIFY IF: - 3-5 years at a US-based DTC brand, Amazon-native operation, or ecommerce agency doing product or category research - You've pulled Brand Analytics. You've used SmartScout or Helium 10 or DataDive in a real job - You can read a Top Search Terms report and explain what 70% click share at 1% conversion share means - You know what a 12 month growth +49% with 1 month growth -3% on a 730-day-old listing tells you, and how that differs from the same numbers on a 90-day-old listing - You recognize branded ingredients (Creapure, KSM-66, Magtein, Affron, GlucoVantage, AstaReal) and can verify a dose or form claim quickly - You understand basic supplement regulatory compliance: structure/function vs. disease claims, NDI status, GLP-1 framing risk, kids product compliance - You understand TACoS at launch vs. mature phase. You can talk to a PPC operator about CPR and rank cost Supplement, beauty, or functional food category experience preferred (supplements strongest) - Native or near-native English writing. Tight. No filler. No hedging. -2-3 hours of overlap with US Eastern Time during business hours required (your specific window is flexible) ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ YOU DO NOT QUALIFY IF: -You're a VA looking for any remote US gig -You've never used Brand Analytics or Helium 10 in a real job -You want a research assistant role with no strategic ownership -AI feels like a threat to your craft -You hedge in your writing -Iterating with imperfect AI tools multiple rounds per project sounds tedious HOW YOU'LL USE AI Our internal systems are AI-powered. The weekly market intelligence report is AI-generated. The product development pipeline is AI-powered. The AI does the heavy drafting. Your judgment is the shipping layer. Expect 3-5 iteration rounds on a clean brief, more on novel categories. Wrong doses. Non-compliant claims. Suppliers we can't source from. Capsule fit math that's off. You catch them, you push back with specific corrections, the system reworks. You're already using Claude or ChatGPT for 30%+ of your daily work. You have opinions about prompt structure. You've hit hallucinations and learned to spot them. YEAR 1 TARGETS 90 days: -Onboarded on the weekly market intelligence system, the product development pipeline, our branded ingredient library, and our regulatory framework - 4-6 niche analyses produced - Catching the majority of compliance errors and supplier mismatches in AI output before founder review 6 months: - 1-2 niche analyses per week as standard cadence - 4-6 of those analyses moved through the build pipeline to packaging or wireframe stage - Owning the unclaimed wedge cross-reference table updates weekly 12 months: - 40-60 niche analyses written across the year - 8-12 SKUs in market or in-progress trace back to your analyses - You own the weekly market intelligence read; founder reviews instead of produces COMPENSATION - Base: PHP 208,000/month ($45,000 USD/year) - Bonus: $2,500 USD per launched SKU that crosses $30,000 USD monthly revenue within 90 days of launch. Uncapped. Paid at the 90-day mark per SKU. - Paid via Wise, Payoneer, or direct bank transfer (your preference), Bi weekly - 20 working days PTO per year plus Philippines public holidays - Laptop and second monitor provided after 90-day mark - 90-day trial with clear deliverables. Both sides can exit cleanly. - Growth path to PHP 250, ---------- ,000/month range in 18-24 months as the role expands HOW TO APPLY Send to ---------- 1. Resume. One to two pages, English. 2. Two writing samples. Research documents, product briefs, strategy memos, internal docs you've produced for previous employers. We're judging the writing quality, not the topic. Work product from a US-based brand is a plus. 3. A 500-word take. Pick a supplement category on Amazon we should NOT enter. Name the category. Name three incumbents on page one. Show your data. Tell us why entering is a bad call. Be opinionated. ChatGPT-generic answers get cut on the first read. 4. A 10-minute Loom video. Open Amazon. Pick one supplement category you'd advise us to enter and one to skip. Five minutes each. Show your screen. Read the data out loud. Don't just describe the listings. Tell us what you'd dig into next and why. If we're interested: a paid 48-hour take-home ($100 USD) where we share a sample market report and ask you to produce one niche analysis. Then a 90-minute video working session with the founder reading data together. Then references. No phone screens. No 6-round panels. Two weeks to apply. One seat. We move fast on the right candidate. Thanks

title: Project Manager
description: Organization: Non Profit Hours: Part-time, flexible (estimated 15-25 hrs/week to start, may grow) Compensation: $7-10/hr USD Time Zone: EST ABOUT THE ORGANIZATION It started with a storm. After a hurricane devastated communities across Puerto Rico, a small team of volunteers showed up with tools, food, and a simple belief: people deserve to be helped. Three years later, that belief has become 200+ missions, 1435+ roofs repaired, 33 farms supported, 1,100 people fed - and a verified world record of 1.1 million acts of kindness in a single week. Now the movement is going global. Our Pay It Forward campaign is scaling to 200 countries with a goal of 1 billion acts of kindness. We are a local Puerto Rico and federally certified 501(c)(3) non-profit, and we operate the same way we always have - lean, mission-first, and built on people who actually care. If you want a role where your work shows up in someone's life, not just a dashboard, this might be your place. THE ROLE You are the glue between our systems and our people. We have a fully built tech infrastructure: Notion, Airtable, Slack, OneDrive, and Claude AI. Our systems developer has designed and documented the full setup and is creating SOPs and training videos. But he's a builder, not a manager. That's where you come in. Your job is to make sure people actually use the system. You help onboard new team members. You follow up when tasks go quiet. You answer questions when someone gets stuck. You are the human layer between a smart system and a growing global team of volunteers. The system is the engine. You make sure everyone knows how to drive it - and that no one stalls out. WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING Onboarding and Training - Onboard new regional managers, country directors, and core team volunteers into the tech stack (Notion, Airtable, Slack) - Walk them through SOPs and training materials created by the developer - Answer questions, troubleshoot access issues, and make sure everyone is set up and confident - Be the first point of contact for anyone joining the global team Project Coordination - Track tasks and milestones across the global team - Follow up with team members on deadlines, deliverables, and incomplete tasks - Send reminders, check in on progress, and flag blockers to leadership - Keep the Notion workspace and Airtable organized and current Systems Support -Know the tech stack inside and out -Identify when something is broken, confusing, or needs improvement -Coordinate with the developer or leadership when system changes are needed -Use Claude AI to support documentation, queries, and process improvements Communication -Attend brief weekly check-ins with leadership -Provide simple status updates on team activity and progress WHO YOU ARE Must-haves: - Solid experience with Notion and Airtable - Experience with AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, or similar) - Must have Project Management experience - Must have reliable internet connection - Experience with volunteer-driven or non-profit organizations is a plus - Experience in Lovable and Wordpress website updating is a plus Personality fit: - Patient and people-oriented - you're working with volunteers, not employees. They need clarity and encouragement, not pressure. - Communicative - you surface problems early instead of waiting for them to grow - Mission-driven - you understand that behind every task is a real person who needed help - Calm under ambiguity - things are still being built, and you're okay with that

The RCM Project Manager will serve as a centralized operational support partner across multiple RCM departments including billing, collections, utilization review (UR), verification of benefits (VOB), payer relations, medical records, quality control, onboarding, and related operational functions. This role is ideal for someone who thrives in fast-paced, high-growth environments and can effectively manage competing priorities, operational complexity, and cross-functional communication while helping executive leadership remain focused on high-impact strategic initiatives. Executive Operational Support - Support the VP of RCM with operational follow-up, initiative management, meeting preparation, and cross-department coordination. - Organize and maintain project trackers, operational dashboards, timelines, and accountability frameworks. - Consolidate operational updates, summaries, and leadership reporting materials. - Assist in preparing executive-level briefing materials, agendas, talking points, and operational summaries. - Help reduce administrative and operational coordination burden from executive leadership. Process Improvement & Scalability - Identify operational inefficiencies, communication gaps, and workflow bottlenecks across departments. - Support implementation of scalable operational processes, SOPs, and accountability frameworks. - Assist with operational process redesign and workflow optimization initiatives. - Partner with operational leaders to improve visibility, consistency, and execution across departments. - Help support automation initiatives and operational readiness for future system enhancements. Operational Reporting & Analysis - Assist with gathering, validating, organizing, and summarizing operational data for leadership review. - Support operational reporting tied to productivity, staffing, workload trends, payer performance, and other key RC ---------- trics. - Help identify trends, recurring operational issues, and areas requiring leadership attention. - Assist in maintaining visibility into high-priority operational initiatives and escalations. Cross-Functional Collaboration - Partner with Revenue Cycle, Sales, Client Success, Product, and Development teams to support operational alignment and execution. - Help facilitate communication and follow-through across departments involved in shared operational initiatives. - Support onboarding coordination, payer initiatives, workflow changes, and operational improvement projects. - Assist leadership teams in maintaining alignment during periods of rapid organizational growth and change. Qualifications & Experience - 5+ years of experience in healthcare operations, revenue cycle management, project management, or operational coordination roles. - Experience supporting complex operational initiatives across multiple departments preferred. - Strong organizational and project management skills with the ability to manage multiple competing priorities simultaneously. - Experience in behavioral health, healthcare revenue cycle management, or related healthcare operations preferred. - Strong written and verbal communication skills. - Highly detail-oriented with strong follow-through and accountability management skills. - Comfortable operating in fast-paced, high-growth environments with evolving priorities. - Strong analytical and problem-solving mindset. - Experience working with operational reporting, project tracking tools, and process documentation preferred. - Proficiency with Google Workspace, Excel/Sheets, project management platforms, and operational tracking tools preferred. - Bachelor’s degree preferred but not required based on relevant experience. Key Attributes - Highly organized operator with strong execution management capabilities. - Proactive communicator who can effectively coordinate across multiple teams and leadership layers. - Strong operational thinker capable of identifying bottlenecks and improving workflows. - Comfortable managing ambiguity and shifting priorities in a high-growth environment. - Able to balance detail-oriented execution with understanding broader organizational priorities. - Collaborative and solutions-oriented mindset. - Strong sense of ownership and accountability. This role will play a critical part in helping leadership maintain visibility, accountability, and execution consistency while reducing operational bottlenecks and improving organizational scalability. The RCM Project Manager will help strengthen communication, execution management, and operational alignment across departments, enabling executive leadership to focus more heavily on strategic growth, operational excellence, and long-term scalability initiatives.

job_title: Demand Planner and Supply Chain Analyst
description: Company: Can Do Brands — a US-based consumer goods company selling mattresses, pillows, foam products, and household goods across Amazon, Walmart, Menards, and other major retail channels. Role: Part-time, long-term, remote. Approximately 20 hours per week to start, with potential to grow into a full-time seat for the right person. Reports to: US-based supply chain lead. What you’ll do You’ll be the hands-on operator behind our weekly demand and replenishment cycle. Each week you’ll pull data from multiple sources — open POs, in-transit shipments, on-hand inventory, channel-level sales velocity, and forecast inputs — load it into our inventory health and ordering model, and produce a clean reorder recommendation by SKU. Specifically: - Maintain and populate our weekly Inventory Health Status, Stock Position, Ordering Requirement, and Incoming Shipments dashboards in Excel. - Calculate reorder quantities using production lead time, ocean transit, warehouse processing, safety stock, disruption buffers, and order frequency. - Flag SKUs that are out of stock, at risk of going out of stock before the next ETA, or carrying too much inventory (overstock). - Keep product master data clean and current — SKU attributes, ASIN/UPC mapping, category, cartonization, cubic dimensions, master case pack, and container fill. - Reconcile PO data and forecast inputs from different sources, catch discrepancies, and escalate when something looks off. - Help us build the supplier order list each week, sized to container/FCL economics where it makes sense. You must have - 3+ years of demand planning, inventory planning, or supply chain analyst experience for a company importing physical goods from Asia (China, Vietnam, Indonesia) into the United States. This is non-negotiable — please do not apply if you haven’t done this work before. - Working knowledge of the Asia-to-US supply chain end to end: factory production lead times, FOB/CIF/DDP, ocean freight, container loading (20?/40?/40?HC), customs clearance, drayage, and US warehouse receiving timelines. - Comfort with cubic dimensions, CBM calculations, master case configurations, and container utilization — you should be able to look at a SKU and quickly tell us how many fit in a 40? HC. - Solid grasp of product master data hygiene: SKU setup, UPC/ASIN/case pack/dimensional weight, parent/child relationships. - Real inventory forecasting chops: weeks-of-cover, safety stock, reorder point, min/max, seasonality adjustments. You should be able to explain the difference between a stockout caused by a forecast miss vs. a supplier delay. - Strong Excel skills: comfortable with XLOOKUP/INDEX-MATCH, SUMIFS, pivot tables, conditional formatting, and working in large multi-sheet models with formula-driven dashboards. Power Query is a plus. - Clear written English and the ability to flag issues proactively — this role lives or dies on catching problems before they become out-of-stocks. Nice to have - Experience with NetSuite (we use it as our ERP). - Experience selling on Amazon Seller Central or Vendor Central (FBA replenishment, IPI, restock limits). - Experience with mattresses, pillows, foam, or other oversize/bulky goods. - Exposure to demand planning tools (NetSuite Demand Planning, Streamline, Inventory Planner, etc.). - Familiarity with 3PL workflows and multi-node US inventory (East/West coast splits). Schedule & logistics Part-time, ~20 hours/week to start. Flexible hours, but expect some overlap with US Eastern Time for our weekly planning sync. Remote, work-from-home. You provide your own computer and reliable internet. We use Excel, email , and Slack. NetSuite access provided. Compensation Hourly rate, paid every two weeks. Rate based on experience — please include your expected hourly rate (USD) in your application. To apply: Send the following to ---------- with the subject line “Demand Planner – [Your Name]”: - Your resume (PDF). - A short note (5–10 sentences) describing one specific time you prevented a stockout or unwound an overstock situation — what data you looked at, what you d ---------- , and what happened. - Your expected hourly rate in USD. - Your earliest availability and weekly hours you can commit. Screening task: Shortlisted candidates will be asked to complete a brief paid Excel exercise (about 1 hour) using anonymized SKU data — calculating reorder quantities given lead times, on-hand, in-transit, and a forecast.

title: SOC Analyst (Level 1–2)
description: Position Summary We are seeking a SOC Analyst (Level 1–2) to join our Security Operations team. Key Responsibilities Alert Triage & Monitoring Monitor security alerts and events across Microsoft Sentinel, Microsoft Defender (Endpoint, Identity, Cloud Apps, Office 365), Netskope, FortiGate firewalls, ObserveIT, Auvik, and NinjaRMM. Perform initial triage of incoming alerts: validate fidelity, classify severity, assign priority, and determine whether an alert is a true positive, false positive, or benign true positive. Acknowledge, document, and escalate alerts per defined SLAs and runbooks. Maintain situational awareness across multiple client environments, tenants, and Azure stack workloads (AVD, Azure VMs, Azure AD/Entra ID, Azure networking). Investigation & Root Cause Analysis Conduct detailed investigations into security i ---------- — pivoting across logs, endpoint telemetry, network flows, identity signals, and user activity to build a full picture of what happened. Construct timelines of events, identify the initial access vector, lateral movement, and impact. Perform root cause analysis (RCA) to determine the underlying conditions that allowed an i ---------- to occur (misconfiguration, missing control, user behavior, vulnerability, etc.). Use Microsoft Sentinel KQL queries to hunt across log sources, build investigations, and validate hypotheses. Leverage AI-assisted tools (including Claude) to accelerate log analysis, summarize findings, draft queries, and support investigation workflows - while maintaining analyst judgment and validation. Response & Next Steps Recommend and, where authorized, execute containment and remediation actions (isolating endpoints, disabling accounts, blocking IOCs at the firewall or proxy, revoking sessions, etc.). Coordinate with Tier 3 / IR specialists and client-facing teams to hand off complex i ---------- with complete context. Document clear, actionable next steps for clients — including technical remediation, policy changes, user education, and follow-up validation. Produce concise, professional i ---------- write-ups suitable for both technical and non-technical client audiences. Continuous Improvement Tune detection rules and analytics in Sentinel and Defender to reduce false positives and improve signal quality. Contribute to and maintain SOC runbooks, playbooks, and standard operating procedures. Identify recurring i ---------- patterns and recommend systemic improvements (control gaps, configuration drift, training opportunities). Stay current on threat intelligence, emerging TTPs, and vulnerabilities relevant to client environments. Required Qualifications Experience: 1–3+ years in a SOC, NOC with security responsibilities, MSP/MSSP, IT security, or similar hands-on role. SIEM: Hands-on experience with Microsoft Sentinel, including writing and tuning KQL queries. Microsoft Security Stack: Working knowledge of Microsoft Defender (Endpoint, Identity, Cloud Apps, O365) and Azure AD / Entra ID. Azure: Familiarity with Azure stack components — Azure Virtual Desktop (AVD), Azure VMs, Azure networking, and core IAM concepts. Network Security: Practical experience reading FortiGate firewall logs, policies, and traffic flows. Endpoint & Cloud Tools: Exposure to Netskope (SWG/CASB), ObserveIT (or similar UAM/insider risk), NinjaRMM (or comparable RMM), and Auvik (or comparable network monitoring). Investigation Skills: Demonstrated ability to perform structured triage, root cause analysis, and produce clear i ---------- documentation. Foundations: Solid grasp of TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP(S), authentication protocols, common attack techniques (MITRE ATT&CK), and Windows event logs. Communication: Strong written and verbal communication — able to explain technical findings to non-technical stakeholders. Mindset: Curiosity, attention to detail, and the discipline to follow process without losing the ability to think critically. Preferred Qualifications Industry certifications such as Security+, AZ-500, SC-200, SC-900, CySA+, GCIA, GCIH, or equivalent. Experience in an MSP or MSSP environment supporting multiple client tenants. Scripting / automation experience (PowerShell, Python, KQL functions, Logic Apps, Sentinel playbooks). Experience integrating or working with AI-assisted security tooling (e.g., Claude, Security Copilot) for investigation and reporting workflows. Exposure to threat intelligence platforms, EDR forensic workflows, and basic malware triage. Familiarity with compliance frameworks (NIST CSF, CIS, HIPAA, SOC 2). What You'll Get A modern, well-instrumented security stack with real depth across endpoint, network, identity, and cloud. Direct exposure to a wide variety of environments and i ---------- types — accelerated growth vs. a single-enterprise SOC. Access to AI-assisted tooling that augments (not replaces) your analytical work. Clear mentorship from senior analysts and a defined progression path from Tier 1 to Tier 2 and beyond. Support for certifications and ongoing training. Working Conditions This role may include shift work or on-call rotation to support SOC coverage requirements. Remote, hybrid, or onsite arrangements per AlphaRidge policy. AlphaRidge is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

description: PLEASE READ CAREFULLY BEFORE APPLYING – Applications that do not follow the instructions below will not be considered. --- POSITION: Amazon EU Marketplace Operations Specialist – Flat Files, Variations & Seller Central Remote (Philippines-based preferred) Full-Time | Permanent | Long-Term --- IMPORTANT: "Please write your application in your own words. We can spot AI-generated cover letters immediately, and they will be disqualified without further review. A short, honest, human-written message tells us far more about you than a polished AI response ever could. Which will all sound the same and make it hard to assess if somebody actually does have the skillset we need. It will be a waste of everybodys time. And therefore we will prefer manual written ones over AI written ones." --- ABOUT THE ROLE We are an established European e-commerce company with our primary focus on Amazon EU. Our largest marketplace is Amazon Germany, where we operate with over 1,100+ proprietary SKUs across all relevant EU marketplaces. We are a growing European Amazon brand with an established presence across multiple EU marketplaces (UK, DE, FR, IT, ES, NL, BE, SE, PL and others). We are looking for a highly experienced Amazon Operations Specialist who lives and breathes Seller Central – someone for whom flat files, variation merging, and bulk uploads are second nature, not something they "have experience with." This is not a management or oversight role. This is a hands-on, execution-focused specialist position. You will be in Seller Central every single day. We are not looking for someone who knows their way around Amazon in general. We are looking for someone who has done exactly this work – day in, day out – and can execute it efficiently, reliably, and autonomously without needing to be guided through it. --- WHAT YOU WILL DO • Upload new main images, A+ Content, and video assets across EU marketplaces with the correct methods per market • Manage content uploads carefully across synchronized and non-synchronized marketplaces to prevent content from overwriting other markets unintentionally • Handle flat file creation, editing, and bulk uploads with full confidence • Manage parent-child variation structures – creating, merging, troubleshooting, and maintaining them • Activate and troubleshoot listings across EU marketplaces • Perform data manipulation tasks directly in Seller Central and via flat files • Handle listing suppressions, errors, and content rejections independently • Coordinate uploads of language-specific content (images, A+, video) per marketplace • Keep a clean, organized workflow across a high volume of SKUs --- THIS ROLE IS FOR YOU IF... You have done this exact work – not supervised it, not assisted with it – you have done it yourself, daily, as a specialist The following scenarios cause you zero hesitation: - A flat file bulk upload throws a "8572 – The value for 'parentage' is invalid" error on 40 SKUs. You know exactly what happened and how to fix it. - You need to update A+ Content on the German marketplace without it syncing to and overwriting the French marketplace version. You know the exact steps. - A parent-child variation has collapsed and child ASINs are floating as standalone listings. You know how to re-merge them. - You are uploading a video that needs to appear on DE and NL but NOT on FR due to content restrictions. You handle this routinely. -> YOU need to know it, not how to look it up. Otherwise the position will end again after a week. If any of the above made you pause and think – this role is likely not the right fit. --- REQUIREMENTS • Minimum 3 years of hands-on Amazon Seller Central experience (EU marketplaces strongly preferred!) • Expert-level knowledge of flat files (all major categories and all tricks and shortcuts) • Deep experience with parent-child variation creation, merging, and troubleshooting • Proven experience managing multi-marketplace EU content uploads • Strong understanding of Amazon's content hierarchy and marketplace sync logic • Experience with listing activations and suppression troubleshooting • High attention to detail and ability to manage large SKU volumes • Reliable internet connection and availability during European business hours (at least partial overlap) PLUS: Experience with DataDive for analytical work and keyword/listing optimization --- WHAT WE OFFER • Full-time, permanent position in a very stable company existing since 25 years • Stable, long-term collaboration with a professional European team • Competitive salary based on experience and output • A role where your expertise is genuinely valued – we don't need someone to learn this; we need someone who already masters it • Fully flexible hours (you dont need to align with us regularly) --- HOW TO APPLY To be considered, your application MUST include: 1. A detailed CV including all relevant Amazon experience (please specify: which marketplaces, which tools, what volume of SKUs you managed) 2. Your current employment status – are you actively employed, freelancing, or available immediately? 3. Confirmation that this is the type of work you do routinely and independently, not occasionally or under supervision 4. Your full-time salary expectation 5. A brief description of a real flat file or variation challenge you have solved 6. Please briefly explain why you are looking to change your current position – or, if you are currently between roles, why your last employment ended. We are not looking for a perfect answer; we are looking for an honest one. IMPORTANT: Your application title or opening line MUST include the word "Knock-Knock". Applications without this will not be opened. This is our way of confirming that you read this posting carefully – exactly the kind of attention to detail we expect from the person in this role. --- We are looking to hire quickly. If this describes your daily work – we want to hear from you.

title: Business Automation Analyst
description: Business Automation Analyst | US-Based MSP | 100% Remote | Full-Time If your first instinct when doing something manually is “this shouldn’t be manual” — keep reading. To apply please fill out the application form here: ---------- /bepartofourteam. About the Company We’re a family-owned business with all-local Philippines leadership and team. We’ve been 100% work-from-home since day one — not a pandemic pivot. We’ve grown by valuing our people, building long-term relationships, and doing great work for great clients. The Role You’re not here to maintain spreadsheets. You’re here to question why the spreadsheet exists — and build the system that makes it unnecessary. We’re looking for a Business Automation Analyst who sees manual work as a problem to be solved, not a process to be managed. You’ll analyze how work gets done across the business, identify what’s slow, repetitive, or error-prone, and build the systems that fix it permanently. Python, advanced Excel, AI-powered workflows, and smart automation tools are your toolkit. The outcome is a business that runs faster, reports more accurately, and depends less on manual effort over time. The Mindset We’re Looking For The best analysts we’ve worked with share a few traits: They see a manual process and immediately ask: “Why is someone doing this by hand — and what would it take to make sure no one ever has to again?” They take ownership. From the ---------- nt a process improvement is theirs, it’s theirs until it’s built, documented, and running without them. They think upstream. Instead of asking “how do I make this faster?” they ask “why does this exist, and should it?” They communicate clearly. Progress, blockers, and outcomes are shared openly — before being asked for. They keep learning. Twelve months from now, they know more than they do today — without anyone telling them to. Who Thrives Here People who are operationally sharp, intellectually curious, and genuinely excited by the idea of making a business run better. You don’t need someone to hand you a list of things to automate — you find them yourself. You’re comfortable with ambiguity, resourceful with tools, and you care more about outcomes than staying in your lane. We’re a growing MSP, which means not every process is optimized and not every workflow is documented yet. For the right person, that’s not a gap — it’s the whole point. What You’ll Do You’ll walk into a business that has real operational inefficiencies — manual reports, repetitive data work, processes that exist because “that’s how we’ve always done it.” Your job is to find them, understand them, and systematically eliminate them. That looks like: Mapping workflows that rely on human hands and asking which ones shouldn’t — then building the automations that replace them Building Python scripts, data pipelines, and AI-powered workflows that turn hours of manual work into something that runs itself Creating Excel models and dashboards that give leadership accurate, real-time visibility — not end-of-week summaries compiled by hand Digging into messy, multi-source datasets and producing clean, reliable outputs that people actually trust Documenting everything you build so clearly that someone else could maintain it, improve it, or build on top of it — without asking you a single question Sitting with teams, understanding how they actually work, and translating that into automation solutions that fit the way they operate — not the other way around Continuously looking for the next thing to improve, because the work is never finished — it just gets better What We’re Looking For Strong Python programming skills — you don’t just write scripts that work, you write scripts that others can read, maintain, and build on Advanced Excel expertise (required) — Pivot Tables, Power Query, complex formulas, dashboards, data validation; you treat Excel as a serious tool, not a last resort Solid experience with SQL and database querying — you can get to the data you need without waiting for someone else to pull it Hands-on experience with AI tools and workflow automation platforms — you’ve actually built things with them, not just read about them Experience with Zapier, Make, n8n, Power Automate, or similar tools — you know when to code and when not to Strong diagnostic skills — you find the root cause of an operational problem, not just the most obvious fix Natural systems thinker — you look at a process and immediately see how it should be redesigned, not just optimized Self-directed once you understand the environment — but you ask smart questions early to get there Honest communicator — you say what’s happening clearly and on time, even when the update isn’t good news Long-term mindset — you want to build something, not just fill a role Nice to Have API integration experience Background in MSP, IT services, or operations-heavy environments How Onboarding Works (And How That Changes) We’re honest about how we work with new tea ---------- mbers. In your first weeks and months, you’ll have real hands-on support from the team. We’ll work closely with you to understand how the business operates, our tools, our standards, and where the biggest opportunities are. We expect questions — and we’ll give you the time to learn. As you show what you can do — and you will — that involvement steps back quickly. Trust grows fast here. People who demonstrate ownership, judgment, and quality work earn autonomy quickly. People who consistently deliver end up with significant latitude to shape their systems, their tools, and how the business runs. We don’t want to over-direct people who don’t need it. But we also don’t believe in throwing someone in without context and calling it autonomy. We earn each other’s trust through real work — then we get out of the way. What Success Looks Like At 3 months: You’ve mapped the highest-impact manual processes in the business and have at least two automation solutions live and running Your documentation is already being used by others At 6 months: Reporting workflows that used to take hours run themselves Teams are spending less time on manual data work and more time on decisions You’ve identified the next wave of improvements without being asked At 12 months: The business operates measurably faster and more accurately than before you joined You’ve built systems that others rely on — and you’re already improving them again How We Work You won’t be micromanaged. We trust our people to do great work and we give them the space to do it. There’s real work to be done — the business depends on it — but we understand that doing meaningful work means making decisions, and sometimes those decisions won’t be right on the first try. That’s how we find the right path. We don’t punish thoughtful mistakes. We learn from them and move forward. We’re a growing MSP, so not every system is perfect yet and not every process is documented. That’s part of why we need someone like you — to help us build the automations, processes, and systems that make us better as we grow. This Role Is Not for You If: You need a detailed task list to know what to work on You build something once and consider it done You document only when asked You’re more comfortable maintaining existing systems than questioning why they exist Your outside commitments regularly affect your availability and focus You’re looking for predictable, low-ambiguity work with clear daily instructions There’s no judgment in that list — it’s just not the environment. We’d rather be honest now than waste each other’s time. What We Offer Competitive salary based on experience 100% remote — no corporate commute, ever Weekly pay via Wise direct deposit Tech and internet allowance Paid vacation leave HMO Access to the latest AI tools (Claude, Cursor, and more) to work smarter and automate more Career growth opportunities in a fast-moving, systems-focused environment

title: Culture & Accountability Operations Lead
description: Remote | Full-time | 9 AM to 6 PM Eastern (flexible, we care about results, not clocks) | Fluent English required Salary: $900 to $1,700 USD per month plus performance bonuses. The Goal of This Role If you are doing this job well, three things will be true about TopFoxx every single month: Culture is strong. The team operates with accountability, urgency, professionalism, and respect. People who do not align with our core values are coached, corrected, or offboarded. Everyone is high performing. Every department has clear KPIs, Rocks, and OKRs that are tracked, owned, and improving month over month. Systems run the company. There are SOPs, scorecards, and Asana structures for everything, and every SOP has been personally tested by you to confirm a layman could follow it. That is the job. Culture, performance, systems. Everything else supports those three outcomes. About TopFoxx TopFoxx is a rapidly growing, women-owned NYC e-commerce brand creating luxury eyewear with real solutions: floating sunglasses, tangle-free aviators, foldable pocket sunnies, and mood-boosting lenses. We are a small, ambitious, fast-moving team scaling quickly. Our biggest opportunity right now is not product or marketing, it is culture, accountability, systems, and execution. We need someone who holds the standard daily, builds the structure that lets A-players thrive, and surfaces and offboards anyone not aligned with our core values. Core Mission Protect, reinforce, and operationalize our culture, standards, accountability, urgency, professionalism, and execution consistency. You are the holder of the standard, every day, across the whole company. This is not a punishing role, it is a reinforcing and rewarding one. You catch people doing it right, praise them publicly, build incentives that reinforce the behaviors we want, and address misalignment quickly and directly. You are how we keep A-players happy and how we make sure we only have A-players. The Stack You'll Run You must be highly fluent in: Asana (you are the guardian of Asana) Slack (team communication and real-time culture monitoring) Shopify (our e-commerce backbone) Google Drive, Sheets, and Loom (documentation and SOPs) AI tools like Claude and ChatGPT, with the judgment to know the difference between a real, tested SOP and "AI slop" nobody can actually follow We expect you to leverage AI to move faster, but to personally pressure-test every output before it ships. EOS / Traction experience is highly preferred. You should already be fluent in Rocks, KPIs, scorecards, OKRs, L10 meetings, and accountability rhythms. Key Responsibilities 1. Culture and Accountability (The Main Job) Be highly active in Slack, Asana, meetings, and team workflows, monitoring communication, behavior, professionalism, and collaboration. Address issues immediately when standards are crossed. Pull people into quick 5-minute calls to correct behavior or clarify expectations. Prevent negativity, gossip, blame-shifting, passive aggression, or poor communication from spreading culturally. Catch and stop "AI slop" in the team's work, sloppy AI-generated outputs that have not been verified or thought through. Document concrete, evidence-based examples of both positive and negative behavior tied to our core values. No vague feedback. Use this documentation for coaching, promotions, reviews, warnings, and determining long-term fit. 2. Positive Reinforcement, Rewards, and Incentive Programs Publicly recognize employees who demonstrate ownership, urgency, preparation, communication, and professionalism. Run a steady cadence of small incentives (Amazon gift cards, shoutouts, peer recognition) for exceptional execution. Design and run structured incentive and commission programs for revenue-driving roles (sales, wholesale, paid media, retention), tying rewards directly to outcomes that move the business. 3. KPI, Rocks, and OKR Ownership You will not just tell people how they are doing, you will go in and check. Shadow each department to understand what people actually do day to day. Build KPI scorecards, quarterly Rocks, and OKRs for every department and role, with measurable weekly targets. Run check-ins, identify bottlenecks, fix root causes, and improve KPIs month over month. Our business is complicated with many moving parts. You will need to dig in to fully understand each role before setting standards for it. 4. Systems, SOPs, and Documentation (Quality-Controlled) Build TopFoxx's operating backbone from the ground up: clear SOPs, step-by-step playbooks, and Loom videos for every recurring process. Standardize folder structures, naming conventions, and templates in Google Drive. Personally test every SOP. Walk through it yourself end to end as if you were a new hire. If a layman cannot follow it without asking questions, it is not done. No AI slop, no theoretical playbooks, no "close enough." Re-test SOPs regularly. A stale SOP is worse than no SOP. 5. Coaching Leaders and Managers Several people on our team are extremely talented in their craft but have never managed direct reports before. You will help build them into great managers. Coach team leads on how to actually manage: setting expectations, giving direct feedback, running 1:1s, holding people accountable, and developing them. Help managers raise the bar of the people they lead, not just delegate tasks. Sit in on tough conversations and model what a direct, professional, accountable conversation looks like. Identify when a manager is the bottleneck and coach them through it, or escalate to the Founder if the gap is too large. Build a simple internal playbook for "how we manage at TopFoxx." 6. Onboarding, 1:1s, and Career Growth You own how people are developed at TopFoxx, from day one through every stage of their career here. Run onboarding for every new hire: be present every day for the first 5 days, then check in twice a week for the next few weeks, then settle into a weekly cadence. Build a job scorecard for every role that defines what success looks like, what the KPIs are, and what "great" means at each level. Build a career growth plan for every tea ---------- mber that maps where they are now, where they could go, and what they need to develop to get there. Hold weekly 1:1s with tea ---------- mbers to check in on progress, blockers, wins, and growth. Make development concrete, not theoretical. Every person should know exactly what they are working on, what they are being measured on, and what their next step looks like. 7. Asana and Project Management Clean up and restructure workflows, create consistent naming conventions, and build repeatable project templates. Ensure every task has clear ownership and a deadline. Create tasks, follow-ups, reminders, and accountability checkpoints. Reinforce review timelines, urgency standards, and deadline ownership. 8. Interpersonal Conflict Resolution Address tension, confusion, or recurring friction between tea ---------- mbers early before it damages culture or performance. Coach people toward direct, mature, solution-oriented communication. 9. Culture Presentations and Team Development Create presentations, trainings, and workshops around our values and standards. Continuously teach the team what "great" looks like operationally and behaviorally, reinforced through real examples and coaching. 10. Hiring, Vetting, and Talent Quality Conduct structured interviews that test judgment, ownership, and real execution ability. Check references thoroughly with hard, specific questions about reliability, speed, and integrity. Validate real past results, not buzzwords. Assess cultural fit against TopFoxx values of accountability, urgency, and clarity. Recommend final candidates to the Founder with clear, evidence-based rationale. 11. Operations Support and Role Backfill While culture, KPIs, and systems are your main focus, you will also help where the business needs it, including temporarily stepping into vacated roles so things do not fall apart while we hire a replacement. Be ready to absorb a vacated role short-term (customer service, ops support, project coordination). Structure workflows across Customer Service, Fulfillment, and Vendors. Create checklists for inventory and orders. Build Google Sheets trackers and handle general assistant tasks and project management for the Founder when required. 12. Reporting and Leadership Visibility Provide leadership with recurring reports on: Cultural health, team accountability, and communication quality. Strong performers, team risks, operational bottlenecks, and alignment with core values. KPI, Rock, and OKR progress across every department, month over month. Manager development progress: who is growing into a strong leader, who is stuck. What We're Looking For 5+ years in operations, project management, performance management, or systems building, with direct experience holding teams accountable and driving culture, not just managing tasks. Experience coaching first-time managers into strong leaders. Experience building KPI scorecards, Rocks, OKRs, and career growth plans that drove measurable improvement month over month. Experience creating SOPs and playbooks that people actually use day to day. Strong command of Asana, Slack, Shopify, Google Drive, Sheets, and Loom. Strong AI fluency (Claude, ChatGPT) and judgment to know when an AI output is good vs "slop." Excellent persuasive written and verbal English. You will be coaching, presenting, and writing for the whole team. Comfortable having direct conversations when standards slip, without being harsh or political. Startup or fast-growing small business experience preferred. E-commerce is a strong plus. EOS / Traction experience (Rocks, KPIs, scorecards, OKRs, L10s) is highly preferred since this is the system we are implementing. What You Get $900 to $1,700 USD per month plus performance-based bonuses, based on experience. Fully remote with flexible hours around 9 AM to 6 PM Eastern. Direct access to the Founder and leadership team. Opportunity to grow into senior leadership as we scale. Free TopFoxx products. Paid time off.

title: Voice Over Artist for Long Form Faceless YouTube Channel
job_title: Voice Over Artist for Long Form Faceless YouTube Channel
description: I'm hiring a long-term voice over artist to be the voice of my faceless YouTube channel — an old-school bodybuilding deep-dive channel focused on the Golden Era of muscle building (Arnold Schwarzenegger, Franco Columbu, Frank Zane, 1970s training). This is a weekly recurring role. The voice IS the brand on a faceless channel — so I'm looking for someone I can lock in for the long haul, not a one-off freelancer. About the Channel: Niche: Old-school bodybuilding history, Golden Era training methods, fitness mythology Style: Faceless / narration-driven storytelling Tone: Dramatic, authoritative, masculine, slightly gritty — think History Channel narrator meets Joe Rogan Video length: 9–12 minutes per script (1,500–1,800 words) Upload schedule: 1 video per week to start (scaling to 2/week within 3 months) Reference voices I want to match: Documentary narrator delivery (think the History Channel "Modern Marvels" style) Joe Rogan's storytelling tone (without the laugh) Magnates Media narrator (calm authority + dramatic punch) The Voice I'm Looking For: ? Neutral American accent — must sound 100% natural to a US/global audience ? Deep to mid-range masculine tone — not too high, not too gravelly ? Dramatic range — must be able to whisper a line, then deliver impact on the next ? Confident pacing — comfortable with strategic pauses and emphasis ? Storyteller energy — not a "radio announcer" or "corporate explainer" voice ?? Voices that won't be a fit: Heavy Filipino accent traces (especially on "th" sounds, short vowels) Overly young / "podcast bro" energy Monotone or "audiobook narrator" delivery Anyone who reads scripts robotically without emotion What You'll Be Doing Each Week:You'll receive: A finished script (1,500–1,800 words / ~9–12 min audio) Inline direction notes Reference clips for tone alignment Your deliverables: WAV file, 48kHz, 24-bit (no MP3 — too compressed for editing) Dry / unprocessed audio — no music, no reverb, no EQ (my editor handles post-production) Recorded in a treated space — no echo, no background noise, no room hum Delivered within 48–72 hours of receiving the script One free revision included per video Requirements: ? Minimum 1 year of professional voice over experience ? Home studio with proper acoustic treatment (no closet recordings) ? Quality microphone (Rode NT1, Shure SM7B, AT2020 or equivalent) ? Audio interface (Focusrite Scarlett or similar) ? Reliable internet for large WAV file transfers (Google Drive / Dropbox / WeTransfer) ? Excellent English comprehension (you must catch the nuance and drama in the script) ? Open to direction and revisions without ego ? Consistent voice across videos — same energy week after week Compensation: $50 USD per finished video to start (paid via Wise, PayPal, Cash App or your preference) Pay increases as the channel grows — I commit to revisiting rates every 10 videos based on channel performance Guaranteed weekly work once trial is complete Bonus structure when videos hit view milestones Trial Process: Apply with audio samples + the test read below Top 3 candidates get a paid full trial — record the first 90 seconds of a real script ($15 paid regardless of outcome) Best read gets the full first video at standard rate If the first video lands, we lock in a recurring weekly arrangement REQUIRED TEST READ:Please record the following 35-second hook and submit it as part of your application. This is non-negotiable — I need to hear how you handle MY script, not a generic demo reel. "You're scrolling through Instagram. Some influencer is telling you their new 'scientifically optimized' workout targets the upper-third of the lateral deltoid. He's got charts. He's got data. He's got a pantry that looks like a small pharmacy. But something's missing… isn't it? Now look at this. The nineteen-seventies. Arnold. Franco. Ferrigno. That raw, thick, three-dimensional look — it feels like a lost art. It's the difference between a CGI explosion… and real dynamite." Direction notes for the test read: Open conversational, like you're talking to a friend Slow down on "But something's missing… isn't it?" — let it land Hit "real dynamite" with weight — that line should feel almost physical Don't rush — the pauses are part of the delivery To Apply, Send Me: 2–3 audio samples of previous narration work (YouTube videos preferred) The required test read above (record fresh — don't send a generic demo) Your weekly availability and turnaround time Your sample rate/format defaults (confirm you can deliver 48kHz/24-bit WAV) Applications without the test read will be ignored. Why Work With Me: I pay on time, every time (Wise/PayPal, cash app fast turnaround) I give clear direction with inline script notes (no vague "more emotion" feedback) I commit to long-term partnerships and growing rates with the channel I respect your craft — you're the brand voice, not a commodity This channel is going to be built around YOUR voice. Let's find out if you're the right fit.
